purpose: engine_digest() hashes every src/pa_milky/*.py file, and saved contracts assert it equals the digest recorded when the study ran. A change to src therefore fails audits whose numbers are unaffected. This ledger records each engine change deliberately, old digest to new, with what changed and why. scripts/report_names.engine_accepted lets a pinned audit accept exactly these recorded transitions, chained in order. It is not a way to wave through a change that moves a number: every transition here must leave the saved outputs identical, and the audits that re-run simulations still compare them.

transitions.reason: Added the tape coverage guard. loader.load_trades now refuses a tape whose windows stop short of config/tape_coverage.json, and provenance records the span each window covered. 303 of 13,846 sweep exports were truncated by an MT5 test that wiped a ~$5,000 deposit; their stats were generated from the same short run, so they reconciled and loaded silently. R:R 1.00 is complete in all 46 tapes, so no saved study read a short tape and no saved number moves.
transitions.evidence: 291 pre-existing tests plus tests/test_tape_coverage.py pass; all sealed baselines re-verify.
transitions.line_endings: Both digests are of the working copy as git checks it out: core.autocrlf is true, so src/pa_milky arrives CRLF. The old digest here is the one the saved contracts pinned, which confirms CRLF is the reproducible form.

caveat: engine_digest() hashes file bytes, and core.autocrlf is true with no .gitattributes, so a digest describes the line endings of the working copy that produced it. The reproducible form is the checkout form, CRLF, and that is what the saved contracts pinned and what this ledger records. The hazard is local: an editor or script that rewrites a src file with LF endings changes the engine digest without changing a line of code, and every engine assertion then fails until the file is restored to its checked-out form (git checkout -- src/pa_milky, or a fresh checkout). Adding a .gitattributes to fix the convention outright would change the checkout form of every src file and so require re-recording every pinned engine digest; that is a separate change.
